name: Legal document intro

documentRef.note: An ENUM, never a body field. mode:clone -> one of the two real signed-off documents (terms-of-use: 25 heading-bounded parts, privacy-policy: 12). mode:generation -> operator-supplied (the deployer's legal owner supplies the text; GENERATION_MODE_LEGAL).

constraints.noFabrication: HARD BAN. assetRole legal.operativeText is pinned to must-not-fabricate. A generator must never write, paraphrase, summarise or 'restore' legal clauses. The schema deliberately exposes no body field for them.
constraints.signOffRequired: This is the real company's operative legal text, ported verbatim. It requires sign-off from whoever owns legal/content before any real deployment.

motion.note: No entrance or scroll animation. Global .btn hover transitions only.

responsive.desktop: first child block of the legal column: the 'Effective date' eyebrow (div on /terms-of-use, h2 on /privacy-policy, identical styling) plus intro paragraphs, no .splitter.

notes: Content is operative legal text owned by legal.operativeText; the PageSpec carries only the document reference.
